title: Linkivo — Smart Link Management PWA
tagline: Discover, Manage, and Explore Links with Intelligence
short_description: A progressive web application for intelligent link management with a weighted discovery system, Firebase backend, and cinematic GSAP animations.
detailed_description:
Linkivo is Turzo's most advanced active project — a sophisticated Progressive Web Application for intelligent link management. It features a Firebase Realtime Database backend, custom client-side SPA routing in Vanilla JS, and cinematic animations powered by GSAP.

The v1.4.5 splash screen animates link cards converging into an auto-locking padlock with particle burst effects and dynamic SVG logo assembly. The core discovery algorithm uses a weighted point system — links with more assigned points are surfaced more frequently.

Key architectural decisions include multi-layer website preview fallback (iframe → OG image → screenshot API → favicon), secure PIN authentication with DOM-hiding via visibility:hidden + inert attribute, intelligent caching with invalidation, and reusable PIN confirmation gates for destructive actions.
content:
About Linkivo

Linkivo is my most advanced active project — a sophisticated Progressive Web Application for intelligent link management. It combines a Firebase Realtime Database backend, a custom client-side router built in Vanilla JavaScript, and cinematic animations powered by GSAP.

Key Features

  • Cinematic GSAP splash screen with narrative animation
  • Firebase Authentication & Realtime Database integration
  • Custom client-side router with SPA architecture
  • Weighted point system for intelligent link discovery
  • Secure PIN lock with DOM-hiding protection (visibility:hidden + inert)
  • Multi-layered website preview system (iframe → OG → screenshot → image → favicon)
  • Advanced caching with invalidation strategies
  • Responsive sidebar with logo-as-toggle behavior

Tech Stack

Frontend: Vanilla JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3
Backend/Database: Firebase Realtime Database
Authentication: Firebase Auth
Animation: GSAP (GreenSock Animation Platform)

Architecture

The app implements a layered architecture: Firebase handles authentication and real-time data sync, while a custom client-side router manages SPA navigation without page reloads. The weighted discovery algorithm assigns probability weights to each link, ensuring varied discovery experiences. The security model uses Firebase Auth for user identity and PIN codes for UI-level locking.

title: QR Prism
tagline: Generate, Scan, and Manage QR Codes with Professional Features
short_description: A feature-rich Progressive Web App for QR code generation, scanning, batch processing from CSV/JSON/TXT, and cloud management with Firebase backend.
detailed_description:
QR Prism is a comprehensive QR code solution built as a Progressive Web Application. It evolved through major versions from Canvas rendering (v2.7) to SVG-based rendering (v3.4) with significant architectural improvements.

The app supports multiple QR generation methods (text, URL, contact, WiFi), batch generation from CSV/TXT/JSON drag-and-drop with JSZip export, a camera scanner with type-based action buttons, and profile management with ImgBB image upload.

The admin system in v3.4 was redesigned with server-side enforcement using Firebase DB structure admins/{uid}: true, moving from a SHA-256 client-side hash to proper server-side verification. The three-tier Service Worker caching strategy ensures optimal offline performance.
content:
About QR Prism

QR Prism is a comprehensive Progressive Web App for generating, scanning, and managing QR codes. It evolved through multiple major versions, culminating in v3.4 with SVG rendering and a redesigned admin security system.

Key Features

  • Multiple QR code types: text, URL, contact card, WiFi
  • Batch generation from CSV, TXT, and JSON files
  • Drag-and-drop file upload with ZIP export via JSZip
  • Built-in camera scanner with type-based action buttons
  • Profile management with ImgBB image upload
  • Messenger-style report/feedback system
  • Three-tier Service Worker caching strategy
  • Secure admin panel with Firebase role-based access

Architecture Evolution

The app migrated from Canvas (v2.7) to SVG rendering (v3.4) for better scalability. Admin enforcement moved entirely server-side using Firebase DB structure admins/{uid}: true, preventing client-side bypass attacks.
